4  THESE APPEALS AND CROBS, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
All the above appeals have arisen due to a single accident.

2. Aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 19.01.2021 passed in MVC No.1262/2017 by the Court of Senior Civil Judge and Addl. MACT, Sira (for short 'the Tribunal'), respondent therein has preferred MFA No.1555/2021 and the petitioners therein have preferred MFA Crob.No.63/2022.
3.
All the appeals have arisen due to one single accident, wherein, one Thimmaiah expired and the petitioner in MVC No.1261/2017 got injured.
4. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to herein as per their status before the Tribunal.

5. Brief facts of the case are as follows:
On 01.07.2017 at about 11.30 a.m. at Hosakere Halla, Amarapura-Thammadihalli road, petitioner in MVC No.1261/2017 was riding his TVS Star City bike bearing registration No.KA.04.HF.7215 along with one Thimmaiah as pillion rider.
At that time an APSRTC bus bearing registration No.AP.02.Z.0361 being driven in a rash and negligent manner came and hit the said TVS.
Because of the same, petitioner in MVC No.1261/2017 got injured and the said Thimmaiah died.
The dependents of deceased Thimmaiah preferred MVC No.1262/2017 and the injured Narasimhaiah preferred MVC No.1261/2017.
6. As the matters arose out of single accident, Tribunal heard both the matters together and passed a common order.

In the impugned judgment, Tribunal has come to the conclusion that the accident happened due to rash and negligent manner of APSRTC bus and has awarded a sum of Rs.7,26,100/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till realization in MVC No.1262/2017 and a sum of Rs.3,85,000/- in MVC No.1261/2017 along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till realization.
7. The said order has been challenged in the aforementioned appeals.

8. After arguing the matters for some time, based on the evidence let in, learned counsel for both petitioners and respondent-APSRTC submitted that the judgment passed in MVC No.1262/2017 may be confirmed and thereby MFA No.1555/2021 and MFA Crob.No.63/2022 be dismissed.
9. In respect of the compensation awarded in MVC No.1261/2017 it was submitted that compensation be enhanced by Rs.50,000/- globally without any interest thereon.
